failure.message: SELFTEST_FAIL e2e001 ⑦AI 要約失敗: AI 操作に失敗しました: AIの回答を取得できませんでした。

cause.effect: Prepared token ignored. E2E001 falls back to devSignIn using e2e-<PID> fixture identity. Unlike voiceask, that fallback does not use the prepared agent email.
cause.summary: The task never started under the prepared host identity. This is fixture setup failure, not evidence of model generation failure or token expiry.

observationMethod: Prepared fixture token GET /v1/me and /v1/tasks; isolated preview PostgreSQL BEGIN READ ONLY projected identity/count queries only. No token, key, transcript, or unrelated user content included.
recommendation: Next driver should pass the /tmp alias to the same existing private mode-600 token. Keep the failed attempt and rerun the actual E2E; no application authentication boundary change required.

separateAIStopObservation.scope: Native PASS demonstrated stop surface remains failed and does not turn successful, initially observing CANCELLING. It does not establish terminal CANCELLED. This task is unrelated to the E2E001 conversation.
